mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox_event (aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, event_id, payload, status, created_at) VALUES (#{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{eventType}, #{eventId}, #{payload}, 'PENDING', NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, event_id, payload, status, created_at, published_at FROM outbox_event WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_event SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = #{publishedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM processed_event WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
